title: Three-dimensional time-periodic problem on the Boltzmann equation with external force
summary: The time-periodic problem for the Boltzmann equation with a prescribed time-periodic external force in the three-dimensional whole space has remained open since it was first treated in [15], where the result was restricted to spatial dimensions not less than five. This paper gives an affirmative answer when the force is sufficiently small in $\mathcal{C}(\mathbb{R};\dot{B}^{-3/2}_{2,\infty}\cap\dot{H}^N)$ with $N\geq 4$.
